headword: {老若男女|ろうにゃくなんにょ}
gloss: men and women of all ages; everyone

definitions.gloss: men and women of all ages, everyone regardless of age or gender
definitions.explanation: A four-character compound meaning people of all ages and genders — literally "old, young, male, female." Used to emphasize that something includes or applies to everyone without exception.

examples.japanese: {老若男女|ろうにゃくなんにょ}に{愛|あい}される{映画|えいが}だ。
examples.english: It's a film loved by people of all ages.

examples.japanese: この{祭|まつ}りには{老若男女|ろうにゃくなんにょ}{問|と}わず{参加|さんか}できる。
examples.english: Anyone can participate in this festival, regardless of age or gender.

examples.japanese: このゲームは{老若男女|ろうにゃくなんにょ}を{問|と}わず{楽|たの}しめるように{設計|せっけい}されており、{操作|そうさ}も{簡単|かんたん}だ。
examples.english: This game is designed to be enjoyable by people of all ages and genders, and the controls are simple.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
The reading ろうにゃくなんにょ uses the Buddhist-influenced pronunciation にゃく (for {若|わか}) and にょ (for {女|おんな}). This is a set four-character compound — the reading cannot be changed.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {老若男女|ろうにゃくなんにょ}{問|と}わず (regardless of age or gender)
- {老若男女|ろうにゃくなんにょ}に{人気|にんき}がある (popular with everyone)
- {老若男女|ろうにゃくなんにょ}が{集|あつ}まる (people of all ages gather)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {誰|だれ}でも: anyone (simpler, more casual)
- {万人|ばんにん}: everyone, all people (literary)
